title: Active Surface-Potential Measurement Design for Physics-Informed Reconstruction of Buried Grounding Electrodes: Reproducibility Package
description: Version 1.1.0 extends the archived numerical reproducibility package with the physical proof-of-concept materials supporting the revised manuscript. It adds the three MTR-1522 field campaigns, the source measurement workbook, deterministic full-grid v5-M80 reconstruction materials, physical map-comparison metric reproduction, and the frozen post-field/post-audit N=15 Active-vs-Space sequential replay protocol, executable implementation, selection sequences, provenance hashes, and derived results. The locked physical replay was frozen and hash-audited before its own outcomes were computed; however, the complete field maps and earlier exploratory analyses were already available. It is therefore retrospective transfer evidence rather than independent prospective field validation. The clean 84-case numerical held-out experiment remains the primary independent numerical evaluation.
